research_question: When complete six-label combinations are absent from training, does MLCNN-classification plus IQ-Grouped-parameter heterogeneous routing retain an advantage over a MAC-unmatched shared MLCNN baseline without relying on unseen-combination threshold calibration?
single_changed_axis: composition-disjoint train/evaluation protocol relative to P4c; C0 shared and C1 heterogeneous architecture/training profile are fixed from P4c

folds.0_unseen_cardinality_1_2: all combinations with 1 or 2 active labels
folds.2_unseen_cardinality_4_5_6: all combinations with 4, 5 or 6 active labels

composition_roles.unseen_combinations: all 100 identities evaluation-only; never train, early-stop, calibrate or select on them

models.fixed_training: P4c cos_lr1e4_wd1e4, width24, head256, param head64, dropout0.2, BCE + 0.1 masked SmoothL1, 20 epochs, model seeds 15041/15042/15043

metrics.contrast: seen-confirm versus unseen-combination gaps for each model
metrics.forbidden_claim: No result may be called a P5b attachment result: the attachment is not used in P5d.

stop_rule: If any promotion gate fails, retain P4c/P5b4 only for seen-composition evidence. Do not add composition prototypes, relations, margins, threshold fitting or experts on P5d unseen combinations.
next_if_pass: Freeze one fixed LSCO fold and conduct two-new-identity confirmation with two fresh generator seeds; only then run a separate long-tail manifest study.
